description: The TokenMark hardware catalogue: unified-memory platforms for local LLMs (AMD Strix Halo, AMD Gorgon Halo, NVIDIA DGX Spark, Apple M Max / M Ultra), plus the GPU cards with measured runs (gpu_cards: RTX 5090, RTX PRO 6000), which rank in their own lane. Without platform: one row per platform (memory, bandwidth, box count, tracked configs) and one per card. With platform: chip specs with a source link per value, the boxes that ship it, Singapore prices, and what no source states; for a card, its VRAM and bandwidth with sources and its tracked config count. Specs only, no speed numbers; use tokenmark_recommend or tokenmark_configs for tok/s.

platform.description: id or name, e.g. "gorgon-halo", "Gorgon Halo", "Ryzen AI Max+ 395", "GMKtec EVO-X5 Pro", "Mac Ultra", "RTX 5090"
